name: Will my home look normal again after interior storm damage repair?
description: Usually yes, if the damaged materials are fully removed, the structure is dried, and the finish work is matched carefully.

mainEntity.name: Will my home look normal again after interior storm damage repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Minor damage may only need drying, drywall replacement, and repainting, while severe damage can require insulation, flooring, trim, cabinetry, and structural repairs. The right outcome is a dry, safe interior with hidden moisture removed and repaired surfaces blended back into the home cleanly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Usually yes, if the damaged materials are fully removed, the structure is dried, and the finish work is matched carefully.
